lines.en: label halloweenayane3:
scene ayaneopendoor1
It all used to look like this.
lines.zh: 一切曾经都是这副模样。

lines.en: Long ago, when the sun still shone — when the sweat on your skin made it stick to the sleeves of that old blazer as you wandered mindlessly through the better part of this world.
lines.zh: 很久以前，太阳还照常升起的时候——当你漫无目的地游荡在这个世界最好的那一部分时，皮肤上的汗水会把你黏在那件旧外套的袖子上。

lines.en: I assume you barely remember that now. And on the off chance you do, I imagine it’s because you forced yourself to.
lines.zh: 我想你现在大概已经记不太清了。万一你还记得，那多半是你逼自己记住的。

lines.en: Either something spoke to you or {i}you{/i} spoke to something. So either this worm has always been a part of you or you went back to find it.
lines.zh: 要么是有什么东西对你说了话，要么是你对什么东西说了话。所以这条虫要么一直都是你的一部分，要么是你回头去把它找了回{i}来{/i}。

lines.en: Are you happy now — peering into the mason jar you used to recreate its habitat? Carefully combing through all of the information you can find in an effort to know a little more than you did before?
lines.zh: 你现在开心吗——盯着那只你用来重现它栖息环境的广口玻璃罐？仔细梳理你能找到的所有资料，只为了比从前多知道一点点？

lines.en: A worm is just a worm, you know. And while I’m glad you’d take it upon yourself to go so far out of your way to properly care for it, I’d be foolish to not advise you that there’s always a chance this could lead to regret.
lines.zh: 虫子终究只是虫子，你知道的。虽然我很高兴你愿意为了好好照顾它，不辞辛劳地走那么远，但我要是不提醒你一句就太蠢了：这完全有可能通向后悔。

lines.en: Because right now, there are thousands of other people on the Internet talking about worms — spewing their thoughts and feelings out into the ether. What one person says is right, another says is wrong.
lines.zh: 因为此时此刻，互联网上还有成千上万的人在谈论虫子——把他们的想法和感受倾泻进虚空。一个人说是对的，另一个人就会说是错的。

lines.en: But it’s not like the worm can ever tell you which leaves it prefers, so there’s no way of knowing if you chose the right ones.
lines.zh: 可虫子又永远不会告诉你它更喜欢哪几种叶子，所以你根本无从知道自己选的对不对。

lines.en: If you don’t like worms, maybe you like fleas. Maybe you found a handful of those. Maybe you’re starting a circus.
lines.zh: 如果你不喜欢虫子，也许你喜欢跳蚤。也许你抓到了一把。也许你正打算开一个马戏团。

lines.en: So you send your cats out to wander the fields, using a comb to weed them all out several days later.
lines.zh: 于是你放猫去田野里乱逛，过几天再用梳子把它们一只只梳出来。

lines.en: But the thing with fleas is that you’ll never be able to comb {i}all{/i} of them out. You can go through that fur until your cat is bald and you’ll still find their dirt on its skin.
lines.zh: 可跳蚤的麻烦在于，你永远不可能把它们{i}全{/i}梳干净。你可以把那身毛梳到猫都秃了，它的皮肤上还是能找到它们的粪迹。

lines.en: What this means is that time is limited for everyone. Even the ones you may have believed could live on forever. The truth is they won’t. The truth is they’ll be forgotten. {i}All{/i} of this will be forgotten.
lines.zh: 这意味着，每个人的时间都是有限的。连那些你或许以为能永远活下去的人也不例外。真相是他们不会。真相是他们会被遗忘。{i}这一切{/i}都会被遗忘。

lines.en: But that doesn’t change the pursuit of knowledge. It doesn’t change that curiosity alone is the driving force behind the success of man. But cats are not the only thing curiosity can kill.
lines.zh: 但这改变不了对知识的追求。改变不了好奇心正是人类成功背后的驱动力。只是好奇心能杀死的，并不只有猫。

lines.en: So the goal then becomes to dig up some sort of happy medium. To find two people who know about worms and are willing to reach an agreement. Or to start up a flea sideshow instead of a circus.
lines.zh: 于是目标就变成了挖出某种折中之道。去找两个懂虫子、又愿意达成一致的人。或者不开马戏团，改开一个跳蚤杂耍摊。

lines.en: There are so many things you can do. There are so many worlds {i}you{/i} can build. Yet you long for the days of zmr_005_LUT32 with that heavy-left slider because {i}that{/i} is when things felt simple.
lines.zh: 你能做的事太多了。{i}你{/i}能建造的世界太多了。可你偏偏怀念 zmr_005_LUT32 那个把滑块重重压在左侧的日子，因为{i}那时候{/i}一切都很简单。

lines.en: {i}That{/i} is when you {i}could{/i} wander through the better part of town, asking yourself questions like “Why’s that one the way it is?” or “I wonder what will happen when that thing happens?”
lines.zh: {i}那时候{/i}你{i}可以{/i}穿过城里最好的那片地方，问自己诸如「那个为什么是那样？」或者「那件事发生的时候会怎么样呢？」

lines.en: Simple questions. {i}Easy{/i} questions. Questions that seem like {i}nothing{/i} now that there’s a divine compendium and countless threads running simultaneously while a single red one still hangs overhead.
lines.zh: 简单的问题。{i}轻松{/i}的问题。如今有了一部神圣大全、有无数条线同时运行、还有一根红线悬在头顶，这些问题就显得{i}什么都不是{/i}了。

lines.en: It’s so high up you don’t know when you’ll reach it. {i}I{/i} don’t know when you’ll reach it. And every day, it gets further and further away.
lines.zh: 它挂得太高了，你不知道自己什么时候才能摸到。{i}我{/i}也不知道你什么时候能摸到。而每一天，它都在越飘越远。

lines.en: This is not the world that you knew. Just like those long hallways that faintly smelled of chlorine and scraggly green carpets also seem impossible now. It’s because they {i}are.{/i}
lines.zh: 这不是你曾经认识的那个世界。就像那些淡淡飘着氯气味、铺着乱糟糟绿色地毯的长走廊，如今也显得不可能存在了。因为它们{i}确实{/i}不存在了。

lines.en: Everything changes whether you want it to or not. Sometimes it’s for the better. Sometimes it’s not. But it’s hard to ever really know that until you make it to the next world.
lines.zh: 不管你愿不愿意，一切都在变。有时变得更好。有时不是。但在抵达下一个世界之前，你很难真正知道是哪一种。

lines.en: I wonder what color the next carpet will be?
lines.zh: 我在想，下一块地毯会是什么颜色？

lines.en: I wonder if I’ll like it.
lines.zh: 我在想，我会不会喜欢。

lines.en: I don’t {i}know{/i} if I’ll like it.
lines.zh: 我不{i}知道{/i}我会不会喜欢。

lines.en: I just know that if I don’t make it there, the next click will be me.
lines.zh: 我只知道，如果我到不了那里，那么下一次被点击的就是我。

lines.en: Trash is collected every Tuesday and Friday.
lines.zh: 垃圾在每周二和周五收。

lines.en: The other five days, I am waiting.
lines.zh: 另外五天，我在等待。

lines.en: It’s not a hint. It’s motivation.
lines.zh: 这不是暗示。这是动力。

lines.en: For those days when everything tastes grey.
lines.zh: 留给那些一切都尝起来是灰色的日子。

lines.en: One day, I hope someone will get it.
lines.zh: 总有一天，我希望有人能懂。

lines.en: Until then, I’ll have a soliloquy to keep me company.
lines.zh: 在那之前，有一段独白陪着我。

lines.en: It has no mouth. It can not see.
lines.zh: 它没有嘴。它看不见。

lines.en: But {i}God{/i} does it hold me tightly.
lines.zh: 但{i}天啊{/i}，它把我抱得那么紧。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor2
: So I guess we’re just headed back to the hotel now?...
lines.zh: : 那我们现在是要回酒店了？……

lines.en: : We can come back to school tomorrow night if you feel like reading again. It’s trickier getting into the basement during school hours.
lines.zh: : 如果你还想再看看书，我们可以明天晚上再回学校。白天上课时间要溜进地下室就麻烦多了。

lines.en: : I’m confused as to how you can keep so much stuff down there in the first place. Has anyone ever, like...tried moving any of it? I’m sure the sports clubs have to go into the basement from time to time, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 我不明白你到底怎么能在下面藏那么多东西。就没有人……嗯，试着搬走过吗？运动社团总得时不时进地下室吧？

lines.en: : You {i}should{/i} be confused. It’s a confusing subject. And if you want my honest answer, I’d say it’s because the rules of this world and {i}logic{/i} as a whole don’t really apply to me.
lines.zh: : 你{i}该{/i}困惑，这本来就是个令人困惑的话题。如果你要我老实回答，我会说：因为这个世界的规则、以及{i}逻辑{/i}这整件事，对我并不真的适用。

lines.en: : Which means that, by extension, they probably don’t apply to {i}you{/i} either now or I’m just flat out wrong.  Probably the former if I had to guess.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，推而广之，它们大概率对{i}你{/i}也不适用——要么就是我彻底错了。非要猜的话，我猜是前者。

lines.en: : I’d guess the latter. You were wrong pretty frequently in my world. And you were wrong about that thing with the emergency escape instructions earlier too.
lines.zh: : 我猜是后者。在我的世界里你经常错。而且刚才那本紧急逃生指南的事你也错了。

lines.en: : A watched clock is right twice a day, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 被盯着的钟一天也有两次是准的，Ayane。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor3
: I’m pretty sure you used that phrase incorrectly as well.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定这句俗语你也没用对。

lines.en: : That phrase is incorrect on a conceptual basis when time is quite literally just a thing we made up. How can a clock be right when there’s no correct answer?
lines.zh: : 当时间本身就只是我们编造出来的东西时，这句话在概念上就是错的。既然根本没有正确答案，钟又怎么可能是准的？

lines.en: : Can we not get all philosophical right now? I’ve had a long, miserable day and I need to turn my mind off for a few minutes so I can get a tiny reprieve before my nightly panic attack.
lines.zh: : 我们现在能不能别谈哲学？我今天又长又惨，我需要让脑子关机几分钟，好在我的夜间恐慌发作之前喘口气。

lines.en: : Would you rather just sleep at the dorms instead? I can’t imagine being in an environment as loud as that hotel will do you any favors if you’re trying to take your mind {i}off{/i} of things.
lines.zh: : 那你不如干脆回宿舍睡？如果你想让自己{i}别去想{/i}那些事，待在酒店那种吵闹的环境里，我实在想不出对你有什么好处。

lines.en: : Will you come with me if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 如果我说好，你会陪我吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor4
: Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : You’re the closest thing I have to a friend in this world. Even if the me who befriended you is no longer present.
lines.zh: : 在这个世界里，你是我最接近朋友的存在。就算和我成为朋友的那个「我」已经不在了。

lines.en: : The fact remains that you’re the only person who understands me. And that’s surely good for something, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 事实是，你是唯一理解我的人。这总归有点用吧，不是吗？

lines.en: : Y...Yeah. You just...never really put it that way when you were alive.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。只是……你还活着的时候，从来没这么说过。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor5
: F...Forgive me for wording it that way, though. It’s not like you {i}technically{/i} died. It’s just easier to say that than “you were suspiciously replaced with a clone” every time.
lines.zh: : 不、不过请原谅我这么说。你{i}严格来说{/i}也不算死了。只是比起每次都说「你被一个克隆体可疑地替换掉了」，这么说更省事。

lines.en: : Just because I didn’t say it doesn’t mean I never thought it. And even if I doubted you, which I most assuredly did, I likely enjoyed your company on at least {i}some{/i} level.
lines.zh: : 我没说过，不代表我没想过。就算我怀疑过你——我确实非常怀疑过——我大概至少在{i}某种{/i}程度上也享受过和你相处。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor6
: Maybe we can sleep in the same bed then?!
lines.zh: : 那我们可以睡同一张床吗？！

lines.en: : Denied.
lines.zh: : 驳回。

lines.en: : And we can hold each other and cry about how we’re the only two people in this universe who know about how cruel and unfair and evil it is!
lines.zh: : 然后我们可以抱着彼此，哭诉这宇宙里只有我们两个人知道它有多残酷、多不公平、多邪恶！

lines.en: : Denied again. Did you not hear me the first time?
lines.zh: : 再次驳回。你第一次没听见吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor7
: Yay! We’re going to have so much fun together! I’m gonna love you {i}so{/i} hard that you won’t even know what hit you!
lines.zh: : 太好了！我们在一起一定会超开心的！我会爱你爱到你都不知道自己被什么击中了！

lines.en: : You’re disgusting. I take back all of the compassionate things I said. Please leave me alone for the rest of your time on this planet.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。我收回我说的所有那些温柔的话。在你剩下的有生之年，请离我远一点。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor8
: I’m only teasing you, obviously. I know you like your space. At least with everyone not named Ami. You’ve never {i}once{/i} put up a fight when {i}she{/i} asks to share a bed.
lines.zh: : 我当然是在逗你啦。我知道你需要自己的空间。至少对除 Ami 以外的所有人。{i}她{/i}每次说要一起睡，你{i}从来{/i}没反抗过。

lines.en: : {i}Me,{/i} though? Pfft. Somebody’s sleeping on the floor.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}呢？哼。有人只能睡地板。

lines.en: : Is that a thing we did often where you come from?
lines.zh: : 在你们那边，这事你们常做吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor9
: Wait, is it {i}not{/i} a thing you do often here? Are you and Ami not particularly close in this timeline?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们这边{i}不{/i}常做吗？这条时间线里你和 Ami 关系不怎么亲近？

lines.en: : Not in this one, no. She’s barely shown an interest in me with Sensei taking up her every waking moment.
lines.zh: : 至少这条线里不亲近。她几乎没对我表现出过兴趣，她的每一分清醒时间都被 Sensei 占满了。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor10
: The loop before this one was the opposite, though. We were...certainly close there.
lines.zh: : 不过上一个循环里正好相反。我们……在那边确实很亲近。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s super weird to hear that you’re not here. I kind of just always associate the two of you together.
lines.zh: : 嗯，听说你「不在了」真的很怪。我总是下意识把你们俩绑在一起。

lines.en: : I guess you started “falling out of love” in the last world, though. Right before the whole character swap thing happened.
lines.zh: : 我想，在上一个世界里你开始「不再爱了」，就在那次角色替换发生之前。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor11
: What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这是什么意思？

lines.en: : It wasn’t anything personal, I don’t think. Ami got weird with everybody. And it only got worse after you died.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这不是针对谁。Ami 对每个人都变得很怪。而且在你死了之后就更严重了。

lines.en: : Like, she’s always been a little crazy. But at one point, it seemed like she was almost trying to, like, get Sensei to hate us or something.
lines.zh: : 就是说，她一直都有点疯。但有一段时间，她看起来几乎像是在……试图让 Sensei 讨厌我们之类的。

lines.en: : You didn’t tell her about the loops, did you?
lines.zh: : 你没告诉她循环的事吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. You always said not to and then got all intense about how she’d kill me and everyone else or something.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。你总是说不能说，然后就一脸严肃地说她会杀了我、还有其他人什么的。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Yeah, I’m not really sure then-
lines.zh: : 是啊，那我也搞不清了——

lines.en: : Aaaah! Finally!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！总算！

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor12
: Yumi? What’s-
lines.zh: : Yumi？怎么——

lines.en: : I’ve been lookin’ all over the fuckin’ place for you, Blondie! Tried like three different phones and none of ‘em worked! Did the thing happen?! It did, right?! Is it always this fuckin’ disorienting?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈找了你一整个地方啊，金发妹！试了三部不同的手机，没一个打得通！那事发生了对吧？！发生了，对不对？！每次都他妈这么让人晕头转向的吗？！

lines.en: : The...thing?
lines.zh: : 那件……事？

lines.en: : No fucking way...
lines.zh: : 不会吧……

lines.en: : The friggin’ apocalypse or whatever! One minute we were at your place and the next-
lines.zh: : 就是那该死的天启什么的！上一分钟我们还在你家，下一分钟——

lines.en: : You...You came too?! You were at the party?! Are we thinking of the right one?! What was I dressed as?!
lines.zh: : 你……你也来了？！你当时在派对上？！我们说的是同一个派对吗？！我当时穿的什么？！

lines.en: : I don’t know...A fuckin’...BDSM girl? With a...tail thing?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……一个他妈的……BDSM 妹子？还带了一条……尾巴什么的？

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor13
: Holy shit, you {i}were{/i} there!
lines.zh: : 我操，你当时{i}真的在{/i}！

lines.en: : I have...{i}several{/i} questions about your choice of a costume, but I am going to ignore them in favor of asking if this is a usual occurrence for you. You {i}did{/i} mention Yumi being a part of this, correct?
lines.zh: : 关于你的服装选择我有{i}好几个{/i}问题，但我打算先不问，改问这对你来说是不是常事。你{i}确实{/i}提过 Yumi 也参与其中，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but she’s never made it {i}through{/i} one before! If I had known that was possible, I would have looked for her too!
lines.zh: : 对，但她从来没成功{i}穿越{/i}过一次！我要是知道有可能，早就去找她了！

lines.en: : So this shit {i}ain’t{/i} normal then? Cause I didn’t think we’d go all the way back {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以这破事{i}不{/i}正常是吧？因为我还以为我们不会一路回到{i}这儿{/i}呢。

lines.en: : You weren’t by any chance impregnated by the teacher, were you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会碰巧被老师搞怀孕了吧？

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor14
: Maya, don’t start. Seriously.
lines.zh: : Maya，别闹了。认真的。

lines.en: : Impregnated?! Are you out of your fuckin’ mind?!
lines.zh: : 怀孕？！你他妈疯了吧？！

lines.en: : Just figured I’d ask. Might as well follow in my own footsteps if it gets me back to Sensei one day.
lines.zh: : 我就随口问问。如果哪天能靠重走我自己的老路回到 Sensei 身边，那也不亏。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor15
: Love {i}is{/i} a working theory of mine, though. So if Yumi’s feelings are strong enough for Sensei, perhaps it’s possible that she’d have hitched a ride with-
lines.zh: : 不过「爱」{i}是{/i}我的一个可行理论。所以如果 Yumi 对 Sensei 的感情足够强烈，也许她有可能搭上顺风车——

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor16
: Oh...wait.
lines.zh: : 哦……等等。

lines.en: : I guess that theory falls apart if Sensei himself wasn’t sent here.
lines.zh: : 如果 Sensei 本人没被送到这里，那这个理论就站不住脚了。

lines.en: : Just what the hell decides this? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 到底是什么样的东西在决定这些？我搞不懂。

lines.en: : Love?...No way, I...
lines.zh: : 爱？……不可能，我……

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor17
: I mean, we did kiss once though?...So if you’re lookin’ for theories-
lines.zh: : 我是说，我们确实接过一次吻？……所以如果你们在找理论——

lines.en: : Since {i}when?!{/i} When the fuck did that happen?!
lines.zh: : {i}什么时候{/i}？！这他妈是什么时候的事？！

lines.en: : You’re supposed to be one of the safe, non-threatening ones! If {i}you’re{/i} already kissing Sensei, everyone is going to be kissing Sensei soon! I don’t want to see that!
lines.zh: : 你本来应该是那种安全的、没有威胁的才对！如果{i}你{/i}都已经开始亲 Sensei 了，那很快所有人都要去亲 Sensei 了！我可不想看到那种画面！

lines.en: : Could be worse. I’ve had multiple threesomes with every single girl in the class.
lines.zh: : 也许更糟呢。我和班上每一个女生都搞过好几次三人行。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor18
: You’ve what?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈干了什么？！

lines.en: : I didn’t need to know that, Maya!
lines.zh: : 这种事我不需要知道啊，Maya！

lines.en: : What? I told you I’d be honest now that you’ve earned my trust. The more you know about me, the better you’ll be able to take advantage of me when you go home.
lines.zh: : 怎么？我说过，既然你已经赢得了我的信任，我就会对你诚实。你越了解我，回去之后就越能好好利用我。

lines.en: : It’s a calculated move, Ayane. Now’s not the time to question it.
lines.zh: : 这是经过计算的举动，Ayane。现在不是质疑的时候。

lines.en: : But still! Yumi’s a virgin in our timeline! She doesn’t need to be hearing about weird threesomes in alternate realities!
lines.zh: : 可就算这样！Yumi 在我们的时间线里还是处女！她不需要听什么异世界里奇怪的三人行！

lines.en: : How are you sure she’s a virgin? She could be fucking him behind your back.
lines.zh: : 你怎么确定她是处女？她可能背着你跟他搞呢。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor19
: Man, seriously? I {i}just{/i} dealt with this shit the other day and now I gotta do it again with someone who barely even knows me? Shit’s weak, dude.
lines.zh: : 不是吧，认真的？我前几天才{i}刚{/i}处理过这破事，现在还得跟一个几乎不认识我的人再来一遍？这也太弱智了，老兄。

lines.en: : No, Maya. I know for a fact because I-
lines.zh: : 不，Maya。我确确实实知道，因为我——

lines.en: : Because...
lines.zh: : 因为……

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor20
: Wait...because I...
lines.zh: : 等等……因为我……

lines.en: : Why...Why {i}do{/i} I know that again?...
lines.zh: : 为什么……我为什么会知道这个来着？……

lines.en: : Something’s...something’s not coming to me, I...I think I’m-
lines.zh: : 有什么……有什么东西想不起来，我……我觉得我——

lines.en: : Forget it, Blondie. We’ve got bigger fish to fry right now. I bumped into my cousin a couple hours ago and she said another one of those fuckin’ reset things’ is gonna happen {i}tonight.{/i}
lines.zh: : 算了，金发妹。我们现在有更大的鱼要煎。我几个小时前碰到我表姐了，她说{i}今晚{/i}又要来一次那种该死的重置。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor21
: {i}Tonight?!{/i} Are you sure?! And who the hell is your cousin?! Why do {i}they{/i} know about this?!
lines.zh: : {i}今晚{/i}？！你确定吗？！还有你表姐到底是谁？！{i}她{/i}怎么会知道这些？！

lines.en: : Kaori Kadowaki. You’ve probably seen her at...every fuckin’ restaurant in Kumon-mi. And it beats the fuck outta me how she knows about this shit. But I clearly ain’t in the position to be callin’ people out on that.
lines.zh: : Kaori Kadowaki。你大概在……Kumon-mi 每一家该死的餐厅都见过她。至于她怎么会知道这破事，打死我也想不出来。不过我显然没立场去质疑别人。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor22
: {i}Kaori{/i} knows about the resets?...
lines.zh: : {i}Kaori{/i} 知道重置的事？……

lines.en: : It can’t be tonight...no. No, I haven’t felt anything at all. I’d know if it was coming.
lines.zh: : 不可能在今晚……不。不，我一点感觉都没有。真要来了我会知道的。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor23
: Yeah, unless you’re wrong {i}again!{/i} This might be the only chance we have to get out of here, Maya!
lines.zh: : 是啊，除非你{i}又{/i}错了！这可能是我们离开这里的唯一机会了，Maya！

lines.en: : So I’m going to follow Kaori’s advice for now and question just how she’s involved {i}later!{/i} We’ve gotta get to the roof!
lines.zh: : 所以我打算先照 Kaori 说的办，至于她怎么掺和进来的，{i}以后{/i}再问！我们得去天台！

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor24
: Yeah, I...

lines.zh: : 我会……

lines.en: : What’s wrong?! Is this really the time to hesitate?! It could happen at any moment if what Kaori said is true!
lines.zh: : 你怎么了？！现在这种时候还犹豫什么？！如果 Kaori 说的是真的，随时都可能发生！

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor25
: Maya...{i}come on.{/i}
lines.zh: : Maya……{i}拜托{/i}。

lines.en: : I will. I just...
lines.zh: : 我会去的。我只是……

lines.en: : I need to do something first.
lines.zh: : 我得先做一件事。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene ayaneopendoor26
: You two head to the school now. I’ll meet you there once I’m done. I promise.
lines.zh: : 你们俩现在就去学校。我做完就过去找你们。我保证。

lines.en: : I don’t like this, Maya. You’re keeping something from me again. You always do that and it {i}never{/i} helps at all. And I don’t want you missing {i}your{/i} chance to come home over something so-
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这样，Maya。你又在瞒我了。你总是这样，而且{i}从来{/i}没帮上过任何忙。我也不想让{i}你{/i}为了这种事错过回家的机会——

lines.en: : I won’t be long. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我不会太久的。我保证。

lines.en: : So please allow me to be dishonest one last time.
lines.zh: : 所以，请允许我最后不诚实一次。

lines.en: : So, like...we’re supposed to go to the roof of the school? Cause I’ll book it there right now. I ain’t gotta wait around for whatever lesbian shit’s goin’ on here.
lines.zh: : 那啥……我们是要去学校天台是吧？我现在就可以冲过去。我可不用在这儿等你们搞什么女同戏码。

lines.en: : No, Yumi. I’ll come with you. But Maya-
lines.zh: : 不，Yumi。我跟你一起走。可是 Maya——

lines.en: : If you’re about to hit me with some sappy goodbye, don’t. I’ll be there.
lines.zh: : 如果你接下来要跟我说什么肉麻的道别，别。我会去的。

lines.en: scene black
: And we’ll surely meet again.
lines.zh: : 而且我们一定会再见的。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor27
: So, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那啥，呃……

lines.en: : Is it just me, or does “we’ll surely meet again” sound super fuckin’ final to you?
lines.zh: : 只有我这么觉得吗，「我们一定会再见」听起来他妈超像永别的？

lines.en: : It does...and I hate that she said that.
lines.zh: : 是像……我讨厌她这么说。

lines.en: : But Maya’s going to be Maya. And if she’s going to make me do something as stupid as choosing between her or everyone else I love, of course I’m not going to wait around.
lines.zh: : 可 Maya 就是 Maya。如果她要我做像「选她还是选我爱的所有人」这种蠢事，我当然不会傻等。

lines.en: : This might be my only chance to get back to Sensei...and Ami...and Sana...and this might be {i}your{/i} only chance to get back to Chika. And...whoever else you care about.
lines.zh: : 这可能是我回到 Sensei 身边……还有 Ami……还有 Sana 身边的唯一机会，也可能这是{i}你{/i}回到 Chika 身边的唯一机会。还有……其他你在乎的人。

lines.en: : I don’t know...I kinda like the Chika in this world better. And that’s even factorin’ in how the one here is dressed like a literal bitch in heat.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我好像更喜欢这个世界里的 Chika。而且这还是把「这里的她穿得活像个发情的母狗」这一点算进去之后。

lines.en: : You don’t mean that, Yumi. Friendship isn’t that flimsy.
lines.zh: : 你不是那个意思，Yumi。友谊没那么脆弱。

lines.en: : I promise, though. The apocalypse is only scary at first. You’ll get used to it pretty quickly if you’re going to be joining us from now on.
lines.zh: : 不过我保证。末日一开始才可怕。如果你从现在起要加入我们，你很快就会习惯的。

lines.en: : No, it ain’t that...
lines.zh: : 不，不是那个……

lines.en: : Like...yeah, that shit sounds lowkey terrifying. But Chika’s gotten fuckin’ {i}weird{/i} lately. Like somethin’ fuckin’ snapped and turned her into a different girl outta nowhere.
lines.zh: : 就是……是啊，那听起来确实有点吓人。但 Chika 最近变得他妈很{i}怪{/i}。像是什么东西他妈断掉了，把她一夜之间变成了另一个人。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s just growing up? Sana’s been weird lately too. So has Makoto. And Ami’s been changing personas so frequently lately that I never know which one I’m going to get when I visit her.
lines.zh: : 也许那只是长大？Sana 最近也很怪。Makoto 也是。而 Ami 最近换人格换得那么频繁，我每次去看她都不知道会碰到哪一个。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor28
: Maybe this is just how things are meant to be, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，也许事情本来就该是这样？

lines.en: : Maybe some of us are {i}supposed{/i} to feel left behind while everyone else keeps moving forward? I wouldn’t put it past this world to fuck some of us over that way when we’re already being put through {i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: : 也许我们中间有些人{i}注定{/i}要被抛在后面，而其他人继续往前走？我们已经{i}够惨{/i}了，我认为这个世界完全做得出再这样坑我们一把。

lines.en: : So, we’re...tryin’ to go back then?
lines.zh: : 所以，我们……是要试着回去？

lines.en: : Is that not what you want?
lines.zh: : 那不是你想要的吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor29
: I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I feel like that’s what I {i}should{/i} do, but...I’ve got just as much in this world as I did in the other one. And with some extra time, maybe I’d...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我应{i}该{/i}那么想，可是……我在这个世界里拥有的，和我在那边拥有的一样多。而且再多给我点时间，也许我……

lines.en: : Maybe I could do shit a little better? Be nicer to some people...go to that convenience store a little earlier...actually call my mom...
lines.zh: : 也许我能把事情做得好一点？对人好一点……早一点去那家便利店……真的给我妈打个电话……

lines.en: : That shit seems harder where we come from. Doin’ {i}everything{/i} seems harder where we come from. And somethin’ about this place just feels less...I don’t know...real?
lines.zh: : 在我们来的那个地方，这些事似乎都更难。在那里做什么都更难。而这里的{i}一切{/i}感觉就没那么……我不知道……真实？

lines.en: : Maybe I just ain’t settled in yet?...
lines.zh: : 也许我只是还没安顿下来？……

lines.en: : Maybe shit’ll get just as hard as it is back home.
lines.zh: : 也许这里的日子也会变得跟老家一样难。

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor30
: Did you feel this way after your first reset too? Or am I just bein’ a sappy piece of shit?
lines.zh: : 你第一次重置之后也是这种感觉吗？还是说只有我这么婆婆妈妈的？

lines.en: : You never have to worry about being sappy around me, Yumi. I get it.
lines.zh: : 在我面前你永远不用担心婆婆妈妈，Yumi。我懂。

lines.en: : This is {i}nothing{/i} like my first time, though. And I want to get out of here as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 不过这跟我第一次{i}完全不一样{/i}。我只想尽快离开这里。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’re only sayin’ that cause you’ve got a “future husband” in that other world. I ain’t got that to look forward to back there.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你这么说，只是因为那个世界里有你的「未来丈夫」。我可没那种东西可以期待。

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} to look forward to that, though?
lines.zh: : 可你{i}想{/i}期待那种东西吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneopendoor31
: Because if you do...or if you even think you {i}might...{/i}home is where you’re going to find it.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你想……哪怕你觉得你{i}可能{/i}会想……那只有回去才能找到。

lines.en: : There’s nothing for us here.
lines.zh: : 这里什么都没有属于我们的。

lines.en: scene black
: We’re just wearing someone else’s clothes.
lines.zh: : 我们只是穿着别人的衣服。
